items.h: Will Reichard makes three field goals Sunday
items.s: Will Reichard made 3-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday. Reichard connected on field goals from 28, 47 and 52 yards out. He missed from 59 yards on an attempt that was blocked. He remains a fairly safe kicker for fantasy managers.

items.h: Makes three field goals in victory
items.s: Reichard went 3-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. Reichard was unable to remain perfect Sunday, but he did deliver at least three field goals for the fifth straight game. The kicker converted kicks from 28 and 47 yards in the first half before later adding a 52-yard make with 1:39 left in regulation, giving Minnesota a 16-10 lead. Reichard's first miss of the season came in the fourth quarter when Grover Stewart got a paw on the kicker's 59-yard try. Reichard is out to a remarkable start to the season, going 18-for-19 on field-goal tries, including six makes from 50-plus yards, over six contests so far.

items.h: Top Billing For Will Reichard Against Colts
items.s: Minnesota Vikings kicker Will Reichard is once again one of the top fantasy options at his position when his team plays host to the struggling Indianapolis Colts. The former Alabama standout has been perfect thus far, making all 15 of his field goal attempts, including all five from beyond 50 yards. In his career, Reichard is 77-for-77 on extra points, and he's currently in the best form of his career. The Colts rank 21st against fantasy kickers and have allowed points on 47% of their opponents' drives this season, the third-worst mark in the league, which should give Reichard opportunities if the Vikings can move the ball. The All-Pro has been dialed in this season, so managers who roster…

Reichard made all three of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries during the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday. Reichard got the Vikings on the board early in the first quarter on a 40-yard field goal before connecting on kicks from 54 and 55 yards in the second and fourth quarter, respectively. Reichard has made at least three field goals in each of his last four games and is 15-for-15 on field-goal tries through five games, which is second-best in the NFL behind Spencer Shrader (16-for-16). Reichard is also one of five kickers who have made at least five field goals from 50-plus yards. The Vikings will be on a bye for Week 6 before welcoming in the Colts for Week 7…

items.h: Will Reichard racks up 11 points in Week 5 win
items.s: Will Reichard converted both of his extra point attempts as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 11 points in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5. Reichard continues a dynamic start to the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, racking up seven or more points in each of the first five games. The kicker remains one of the more dynamic options in associated formats as Minnesota enters a Week 6 bye.

items.h: Locked-In Will Reichard An Easy Starter In Week 5
items.s: Riding a year-long hot streak, Minnesota Vikings kicker Will Reichard can be started in every format when his team takes on the New Orleans Saints in Week 5. The All-Pro has made 31 straight field goals dating back to last season, including all 12 attempts this year. For better or worse, Reichard has been Minnesota's most reliable way to score this season, tying for the league lead in points scored at his position. The Saints surrendered 45 points last week, rank in the bottom three against fantasy kickers, and the indoor setting takes away most of the unfriendly variables for a kicking operation. As long as he's healthy, Reichard should have lineup potential. He is RotoBaller's No. 5…

items.h: Will Reichard scores 15 points in win Sunday
items.s: Will Reichard made all five of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins. Reichard had a great game on Sunday, being responsible for all 15 of Minnesota's points in their close win over the Dolphins. He should continue to be a viable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

items.h: Converts five field goals in win
items.s: Reichard went 5-for-5 on field-goal attempts during Sunday's 15-10 win over the Dolphins. Reichard provided all of the offense for Minnesota in Week 4. The kicker made field goals of 47, 50 and 33 yards in the first half before later adding a 41-yarder in the third quarter and a 29-yard make in the fourth quarter. Reichard has been perfect this season, going 12-for-12 on field-goal tries, including four makes from 50-plus yards, while converting all six of his PATs over four contests so far.

items.h: Will Reichard Brings Starting Potential In Week 4
items.s: Minnesota Vikings kicker Will Reichard can be considered a solid starting option when his team plays host to the Miami Dolphins in Week 4. So far, the All-Pro kicker has been excellent, hitting all seven of his field goal attempts and all six of his extra points to rank fourth among fantasy kickers. The Vikings' offense is coming off one of its worst offensive stretches since it hired head coach Kevin O'Connell in 2022, but the Dolphins have struggled in virtually every area, and they rank 27th against fantasy kickers. Minnesota's blueprint of harassing opposing teams with exotic blitzes and doing just enough on offense hasn't been pretty, but it's keeping Reichard playable in any format…

items.h: Will Reichard makes five kicks Sunday
items.s: Will Reichard connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday. Reichard made field goals from 54, 56 and 43 yards out. He hit two huge field goals late in the fourth quarter to help Minnesota hold off the Bucs.
